name: Iinari Cosplayer Kanami-chan no Shuuchi Satsueikai
original_name: いいなりコスプレイヤーかなみちゃんの羞恥撮影会
source:
The girl who showed up at the event venue was rumored to be the kind of cosplayer who’d do any lewd pose—a girl who’d say yes to anything.

Kanami, a girl with a passion for cosplay, had always enjoyed her hobby in her own way. But one ordinary afternoon after school, she fell into a trap set by a man and was raped.
From that day on, she had no choice but to become her "master’s" obedient plaything. And with that, her lewd misfortunes began…

translation:
出现在活动会场的女孩被传为会摆出任何下流姿势、对任何要求都说“好”的Cosplay玩家。

热爱Cosplay的加奈美一直以自己的方式享受兴趣。然而，一个普通的放学午后，她落入男人设下的陷阱，遭到强奸。
从那天起，她只能成为“主人”顺从的玩物。她下流的不幸就此开始……
